description: Report the product name, version and release qualification. Read-only; does not access files or external services.
name: get_status

description: Read stored quota metrics from the local service. Does not contact providers or start models. Narrow account or model scope if the result is too large.
name: get_quota

description: Rank configured providers and their models by stored quota capacity (highest first), applying Quota's provider and account multipliers. Shows each model's status (available, limited, unknown, priority_overflow, exhausted), remaining percentage, limiting window, reset and evidence freshness. Account-free: no account or pool identities. Read-only; does not contact providers or start models.
name: get_capacity
